_: Resolution table for the #onward cross-sell band (AD-17 §4). Written by content, against the AD-17 data schema §4. THREE THINGS TO RAISE WITH THE LEAD, not resolved here: (1) `situations[].href` — the schema §5 clause 5 rejects any href on a `/design/` path, but the only situation destinations that resolve at all are the seven `public/design/v3/situation-*.html` prototypes, and the frozen homepage itself links to them at that path (home.html:3775, 3783). The path below is therefore the one that resolves, and it is the one the schema forbids. It needs a canonical situation route or an explicit exemption. (2) `evidence` is not in the schema; slot 3's rule is '/#farm if the work happens at the farm, else /#record', which is a content fact and cannot be derived from any item field, so it is stated here rather than invented per page. (3) kinds.json has no field for the kind-landing masthead photograph that AD-17 §5B/§5C band 1 calls for; no kind is assigned one.

_note_closing_2026_08_23: THE CLOSING BAND ON THE SIX SITUATION PAGES. Audit finding, 23 August: five of the six carried forty Google News links and one or two links into Swechha's own work; heat, forest fire and forest loss had none at all. The pages did data -> understanding -> implications well and then handed the reader to a news aggregator. This register is the ending they were missing. EVERY ENTRY MUST CARRY BOTH HALVES: `doing` is what Swechha actually does about this reading, and `limit` is why it is not a reply to the number at the top of the page. The second half is not modesty, it is the same rule the rest of the site runs on -- /now already says 'fifty thousand surviving trees is a real number and it is not a reply to 2.43 million hectares'. A promotional band here would contradict the page it sits on. situation-shell.mjs's closing() refuses to render an entry missing either.

air.doing: One campaign with a name on it, and a slower thing underneath. Delhi I Can’t See You is the public push; air is also a module in the schools curriculum, and the CityScapes walks take people to the places these readings are taken.
air.limit: None of it moves an AQI of 307. A campaign changes what a city is willing to say about its air; it does not change what the city burns. The reading at the top of this page is the honest measure of that distance, which is why it is printed before any of this.

yamuna.doing: This organisation began as We for Yamuna in 2000 and the river is still its spine. Thirty Yatras since 2004 have walked over ten thousand young people from Yamunotri to Agra, and the Shramdaan days clean the bank in public.
yamuna.limit: All of that is people, and the river’s problem is 1,582 MLD of sewage a day that reaches it without being treated to the standard. Clearing a bank does not put oxygen back in water. Dissolved oxygen at 0.3 mg/L against a legal floor of 5.0 is not a measure of how many turned up; it is a measure of what Delhi builds and then runs.

heatwave.doing: Eco Action builds the small green infrastructure a city actually has room for — over seventy butterfly parks and over twenty herb gardens across Delhi NCR. In one Vasant Kunj park, green cover went from 5% to 90% over a decade.
heatwave.limit: That is one park, and heat is regional. Shade cools the body standing under it and nothing past that: it does not lower the 48.3°C in this archive and it did not prevent the 1,832 deaths recorded in 2024. A canopy is a real intervention at the scale of a bus stop. The reading is at the scale of a country.

fire.doing: Monsoon Wooding plants about five thousand trees a year across Delhi NCR, and over fifty thousand have been planted and survived.
fire.limit: Planting is not fire suppression, and Delhi NCR is not a forest state. Fifty thousand surviving trees is a real number and it is not a reply to 34,562 square kilometres of burnt forest. Both are on this site, in their own units, and neither is used to cancel the other.

loss.doing: Monsoon Wooding — about five thousand trees a year in Delhi NCR, over fifty thousand planted and survived. Survived is the organisation’s own word for it and it is the honest one: planting is not the same measurement as living.
loss.limit: Fifty thousand surviving trees is a real number and it is not a reply to 2.43 million hectares. It is also the wrong instrument: a forest is lost with paperwork, and it is not recovered by planting somewhere else.

climate.doing: Mostly the written record, and going to look. Three of the essays on this site were reported out of flood years, and Gram Anubhav takes groups into villages living with this, run with over a hundred grassroots partners in the villages themselves.
climate.limit: Publishing and going to see are not resilience. Swechha does not build drainage, and nothing here reduces the 3,594 deaths this page counts. What the work does is make the count harder to ignore — a smaller claim than it sounds, and the only one the evidence supports.
